name: Opera Browser CLI
desc: Command line that lets a local AI agent drive Opera Neon.
desc_zh: 让本地智能体用命令行驱动 Opera Neon 浏览器的工具
solves: An agent could not use a browser without a full GUI automation stack. This CLI wraps Opera Devtools so a terminal or an agent opens pages and reads them by command.
solves_zh: 智能体要用浏览器，过去得搭一整套界面自动化。这个 CLI 封装了 Opera Devtools，让终端或智能体用命令打开页面、读取内容。
best_for: Your agent needs to open a page and read it, and you would rather not drive a GUI.
best_for_zh: 你的智能体要打开一个页面并读取内容，而你不想去驱动图形界面。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://blogs.opera.com/news/category/ai/ (Opera's own news directory), then）。 Installed with npm install -g opera-browser-cli. Opera describes it as a command-line wrapper around opera-devtools that lets a local AI agent drive any Opera browser; the setup scripts include Skills for Claude Code by default. The announcement post's own headline reads 'Introducing `opera-browser-cli`: a Command Line Interface to run Opera Neon'. The npm registry page for the package returned 403 to automated fetches, so the GitHub repository is used as the homepage. 评审修正（2026-11-25）：原名字是仓库的包名 opera-browser-cli；按产品名写。 首次公开日期来源：https://blogs.opera.com/news/2026/05/opera-browser-cli/
